test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The pilot along with his crew __have gone on__ vacation for a month.
solution: The correct answer is 'has gone on.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The error lies in **have gone on** part of the sentence. • When the phrase **along with **is used in a sentence, then the verb agrees according to the subject before** 'along with'.** • **Example: ***Riya **along with** her friends is going to a party. * • Here, the subject **'Pilot'** is singular. • Hence, a singular verb should be used. • Therefore, the use of 'have gone on' should be replaced by 'has gone on' to make it grammatically correct*.* • Therefore, the correct answer is 'has gone on.' • *​​*Correct sentence__: *The pilot along with his crew **has gone on** vacation for a month.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** * __ • The present tense is the base form of the verb. • We use do and does to make questions with the present simple. • We use does for the *third person singular (she/he/it)* and do for the others. • We use do and does with question words like *where, what *and* when.* • Example: *Where do Angela and Rita live?* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97964f99b09172b00906880345c25bb77b19df28604cb110ee4b32fdb8906ba3.png] Hinglish__ * • त्रुटि वाक्य के भाग have gone on में है। • जब वाक्य में phrase along with का प्रयोग किया जाता है, तो क्रिया'along with' से पहले subject के अनुसार सहमत होती है। • Example: *Riya along with her friends is going to a party. *​ • यहाँ subject 'Pilot', singular है। • इसलिए singular verb का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • इसलिए वाक्य के 'have gone on' प्रयोग को 'has gone on' से बदल देना चाहिए ताकि वह व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही हो।​ cc:T8fb, The correct answer is: **By whom has my pen been taken away?**
